functions.purpose: TDR text/debug serializer for a Level-Mode-Stat struct. Dumps [levelMode] then [modeStatCnt], validates count, then two parallel arrays [modeStatType] (u8) and [modeStatVal] (u32).

modeStatVal[]: u32 array @ +0xf, element i = *(u32*)((int)param_1 + i*4 + 0xf)
costs: modeStatVal entries likely reward/stat values (semantics not in this func)
functions.serverRelevance: validation/schema: defines the level-mode stat block layout (max 10 type/value pairs) used in level config messages; server owns level mode definition. This is the debug-dump direction.
functions.notes: Value array printed with DAT_11d9f608 fmt string. TdrText_* = Tencent TDR text serializer plumbing.

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for the FixedTimesBlock struct (dump direction; matches TlvFixedTimesBlock read at 0x1015F270 in schema docs). Level completion/quest block with a completeBit array plus levelId/levelResult.
formulas: struct: +0x0 fixedTimes(i32); +0x4 blockArg1; +0x8 blockArg2; +0xc blockArg3; +0x10 blockArg4; +0x14 completeBitCount(i32)
completeBit[]: u8 array @ +0x18, element i = *(char*)((int)param_1 + 0x18 + i)
CAP: completeBitCount < 0 return -6; completeBitCount > 5 return -7 (max 5 complete-bits)
functions.serverRelevance: validation/schema: cross-referenced with TLV_DOCS/TlvFixedTimesBlock.md (fields fixedTimes, blockArg1-4, completeBitCount, completeBit, levelId, levelResult). Server evaluates level completion / fixed-times gating.
functions.notes: Confirms schema field names 1:1. blockArg offsets 1-4 are consecutive i32 (per doc field offsets).

functions.purpose: TDR text serializer for the instance/battleground creation descriptor — the parameters used to spin up an instance level: battleground id, level id, max players, game mode, time/weather, world time, rand seed, warning flag, max player level.

costs: iCreateMaxPlayerCount = instance player capacity gate; iCreatePlayerMaxLv = max level allowed to create/join

Server must generate iLevelRandSeed and enforce iCreateMaxPlayerCount / iCreatePlayerMaxLv.
